description: End another open session of this project, only after the user has approved it. Use it when aide_observer_start answers HALT and the user chooses to end the session it names: pass `sessionId` exactly as the HALT line gave it — an observer session id, or the Claude session id of a session that never reported (written `claude:<id>` in the HALT; pass the id without the `claude:` prefix). Ending only writes a mark that the session has ended: it deletes no log, presence or project file, and the ended session's further reports are refused. It never ends the caller's own session. Replies are one line: `ended <id>`, `already ended <id>`, `refused: <id> is this session`, `refused: no session <id> in this project`, `refused: invalid session id`, or `not ended (<reason>)` when the disk could not be written. After `ended`, call aide_observer_start again.
name: aide_observer_end_session
